versions.changelog: Fix @noble/curves v2.x compat — wrap all getPublicKey/getSharedSecret calls with hexToBytes()
Fix @noble/curves import — use ./secp256k1.js (v2.x requires .js extension, was breaking on fresh install with Node 22)
Add preview image to SKILL.md — ClawHub renders SKILL.md not README
Fix preview image — use absolute GitHub raw URL so it renders on ClawHub skill page
Add Installation section to README — explains where to run 'openclaw skills install safetok-bridge'

Initial release of safetok-bridge — a bridge connecting safeTok Nostr DMs to OpenClaw.

- Connects safeTok NIP-44 encrypted DMs from your phone to OpenClaw using Claude OAuth (no Anthropic API key required)
- Enables bidirectional, end-to-end encrypted communication with your OpenClaw agent via Nostr
- Provides setup instructions and outlines requirements
- Includes main bridge and NIP-44 crypto primitive files
